description:
Use to discover, vet, and load agent skills from the open ecosystem — either installed permanently or loaded for a single session.

Trigger when the user: asks for a skill or extra tooling for any topic ("find me a skill for Terraform", "is there a skill that…"); names a skill, owner, or repository to inspect or try; or asks you to extend, upgrade, or fill gaps in your own capabilities before helping them.

Also trigger before substantial specialist work where an expert playbook would help — infrastructure and deployment (Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC), framework-specific implementation, migrations, testing strategy, data or document tooling — when no installed skill covers that domain. Check the available-skills list first; search the ecosystem only if nothing there fits.

Skip for quick edits, debugging, or questions you can answer directly. Always offer a choice between installing and one-off loading before running anything.

is there a skill that can review SQL migrations?

what are you missing to help me better with frontend work? get yourself some tooling
I need to set up canary deployments on Kubernetes with automatic rollback
put together a testing strategy for a legacy Django monolith
this test is failing on the assert, fix it
rename the variable userId to accountId across all files

create a brand new skill from scratch for reviewing pull requests
